target: Roland S-760 IC15 boot ROM v1.11
rule: Count passed gates divided by all defined gates. Equal binary acceptance gates; no partial credit and no inference about effort/time remaining. Open/blocked both score0. Not an overall OS/project or hardware-fidelity percentage.
scope_change_policy: Freeze v1 paths and acceptance criteria. New independent functionality requires a versioned scope amendment and an explicit old/new denominator and baseline; new details within a path refine evidence without silently changing its gates. Never drop a failed path to improve score.

gate_definitions.context: Justified entry/caller/gate and explicit fetch/data context under recorded conditions; conditional proof can pass, physical invocation is not implied.
gate_definitions.layout: Instruction/data boundaries, relevant widths and extents independently checked for the path.
gate_definitions.behavior: Inputs, outputs/state transitions and error/terminal behavior explained within the declared path scope.
gate_definitions.execution: Ordinary unchanged-firmware native execution validates the path acceptance condition; isolated component tests alone are insufficient.

assumptions.rule: Presume remainingFF space unused unless contrary evidence appears. Preserve original bytes. Not a failing gate or verified code/data.

separate_unscored_requirements: Physical power-on selector defaults, bus/interrupt timing and real hardware parity
Assembler/source generation, byte-exact rebuild and modified-firmware acceptance (Milestone7)
Full OS behavioral completion; its inventory/denominator is not yet established

paths.title: Reset and startup selection
paths.scope: Native retained reset mapping, initialization and boot decision; physical power-on selectors excluded.

context.acceptance: Reset/vector roots and retained fetch/data selectors documented.

layout.acceptance: Reset encodings, vectors and startup configuration accesses bounded.

behavior.acceptance: Initialization order and saved-device branches documented.

execution.acceptance: Unchanged ROM reaches startup and OS handoff with fresh native state.

paths.title: Successful floppy OS load
paths.scope: Header, complete payload and OS handoff from unchanged full-size floppy.

context.acceptance: Loader caller and fetch/data contexts established.

layout.acceptance: Header signature, payload extent, destinations and instruction boundaries documented.

behavior.acceptance: Read sequence, density choice and handoff explained for accepted full media.

execution.acceptance: Native trace matches all112 payload transfers and handoff.

paths.title: Floppy errors and recovery
paths.scope: Invalid signature, density/short-media handling and genuine transport-error/retry behavior.

context.acceptance: Error-loop call sites and contexts established.

layout.acceptance: Checks, status fields and recovery branches decoded.

behavior.acceptance: Each error cause, retry transition and cleanup distinguished; genuine transport retry contract completed.

execution.acceptance: Represented transport error/retry and short-media behavior qualified without forcing guest state.

paths.title: SCSI command/header and fallback
paths.scope: Selection, counted CDB, header validation and absent/bad-header fallback; payload separate.

context.acceptance: Command/header callers and mapping contracts established.

layout.acceptance: CDB record widths, buffers and header checks bounded.

behavior.acceptance: Active/completion, timeout, signature rejection and fallback explained.

execution.acceptance: Ordinary menu input qualifies command transfers and absent/bad-header floppy fallback.

paths.title: SCSI payload DMA completion
paths.scope: IC4 control47 count, completion interrupt and SCSI-to-OS handoff.

context.acceptance: DMA interrupt delivery, vector selection and acknowledgment context established.

layout.acceptance: ROM DMA setup, count encodings and wait/handler instructions mapped.

behavior.acceptance: Full-count extent, completion/acknowledgment and failure handling explained independently.

execution.acceptance: Original ROM loads full SCSI OS payload and reaches OS via ordinary input.

paths.title: Front-panel setup menu
paths.scope: Five valid-state setup fields and ordinary control actions.

context.acceptance: Setup entry gate and display/data contexts established.

layout.acceptance: Field locations, labels and limits bounded.

behavior.acceptance: Selection, clamps, display updates and exit/save flow explained.

execution.acceptance: Ordinary input qualifies both limits of all five fields.

paths.title: EEPROM persistence
paths.scope: 64-word read/write/verify and setup persistence in native model.

context.acceptance: Read/write/save callers and mapping context established.

layout.acceptance: Word count, serial operations and configuration layout bounded.

behavior.acceptance: Read, write, verification and configuration initialization flow explained.

execution.acceptance: Ordinary save, reread and fresh-process reboot preserve expected values.

paths.title: Boot display and referenced resources
paths.scope: ROM display transactions, glyph/bitmap addressing and setup output; physical timing excluded.

context.acceptance: CRT/LCD entry sites and resource mapping established.

layout.acceptance: Referenced text, glyph, bitmap bounds and transfer widths mapped.

behavior.acceptance: Addressing, transaction order and geometry/count behavior documented for boot/setup.

execution.acceptance: Native upload/output transactions match original-ROM resource contracts.

paths.title: Startup audio initialization
paths.scope: ROM table-driven initialization transactions; full audio-chip semantics excluded.

context.acceptance: Startup caller and data selectors established.

behavior.acceptance: Exact write destinations, values and order explained.

paths.title: RAM self-test
paths.scope: 4028 test, success/failure reporting and selector restoration.

context.acceptance: Conditional startup gate and ROM fetch context documented; physical button identity unresolved.

layout.acceptance: 63-page test extent, patterns and progress resources bounded.

behavior.acceptance: Three-pattern comparisons, page alias checks and terminal outcomes explained.

execution.acceptance: Supported ordinary diagnostic input reaches test and qualifies success/failure behavior.

paths.title: Serial monitor and continuation
paths.scope: 4000 ->01A0 manual frame, commands and g/G handoff.

context.acceptance: Conditional monitor gate, internal stack and bank restoration context documented.

layout.acceptance: Command paths and16-byte save/restore frame decoded.

behavior.acceptance: Read/write commands, input loop and g/G continuation explained.

execution.acceptance: Supported entry and serial input exercise original monitor commands and continuation.

paths.title: FDC interrupt and boot stack
paths.scope: Native FDC interrupt routing, FIFO result drain and original-ROM stack accounting.

context.acceptance: Observed level13/vector203A/target0120 and retained contexts documented.

layout.acceptance: FIFO result/flag state and stack frames bounded.

behavior.acceptance: Register/flag restoration and handoff caller word explained.

execution.acceptance: Actual IRQ logs reconcile171 return-word writes and observed boot stack balance.

paths.title: Other low ROM interrupt stubs
paths.scope: Structural0124..013D/02E0 paths; not an assumption of real IC4 routing.

context.acceptance: Real source-to-vector delivery and mapping contracts established.

layout.acceptance: Stub and handler encodings, touched registers and branches mapped.

behavior.acceptance: Static flag/port operations and local state changes explained conditionally.

execution.acceptance: Independent ordinary invocation validates delivery/acknowledgment for these sources.

paths.title: Structural-only helper family
paths.scope: Uncalled fill, graphics, delay and EEPROM helper bodies.

context.acceptance: Justified callers or supported alternate invocation contexts established for structural-only entries.

layout.acceptance: Bounded helper encodings/data classified with original-byte evidence.

behavior.acceptance: Documented arithmetic, loops, widths and side effects retain invocation qualifications.

execution.acceptance: Original firmware invokes representative remaining helper contracts via supported inputs.

paths.title: Unreferenced resources and final byte
paths.scope: Dormant self-check strings, controller placeholder and6903 command-constant candidate.

context.acceptance: Consumers/ownership or an explicitly accepted unused classification established for remaining resources.

layout.acceptance: String bounds and final raw08 byte position independently recorded.

behavior.acceptance: Role or non-use established beyond observed-path absence; author intent not invented.

execution.acceptance: Relevant dormant consumer or accepted non-use contract validated; current negative traces alone do not close this.
